provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3535 WILCREST DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77042

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Date of admission was missing on file for one child. This was corrected during inspection by the owner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported their staffing changes for the year 2024 by the due date of 1/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: Caregiver was attending to 6 children during naptime with an age group of 12-17 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Lighting in the gymnasium was too dim to be able to see children alseep or the other caretaker at other end of the gym.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Caregiver had education requirements fulfilled outside of US, but it was not translated into english.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Date of admission was missing on file for one out of four records checked. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five records reviewed two staff did not have the full 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Updated immunization records are needed for two children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A caregiver was observed at the operation and in a classroom assisting another caregiver with 25 children between the ages of 3y-5y old without an initial background check on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed in the Primary 3 classroom caring for 25 children between the ages of 3yr and 5yr. old. It was determined the specified age group is 3 years old, which made this classroom out of child/caregiver ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System: The sign in and out sheet in the Primary 3 classroom was reviewed and showed 20 of 25 children present were signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(b))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: A caregiver was observed at the operation, in a classroom, and caring for children. It was determined the caregiver does not meet the education qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: The caregiver in the Primary 3 classroom stated 18 children were present. A total of 25 children were observed present in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: One staff member needs 24 hours of Pre-Service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two caregivers needed training in all special topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The employee list posted shows 10 of 17 staff members.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Food Allergy Emergency Plans were reviewed for three children in care and the following was observed:     Parent signature is needed for one child in care.    Physician signature is needed for one child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: An incident report was observed in one child's file during the inspection. The child's parents had not signed the report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: 2 staff members completed online CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Provided By: Trainings were reviewed during this inspection and it was determined the operation provided trainings to staff members. The operation received an administrative penalty on 10/12/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Provided By (26 TAC §746.1317(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Updated immunization records are needed for two children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include the following:    -Procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency.    -How you will communicate with local authorities (such as fire, law enforcement, emergency medical services, health department), parents and Child Care Regulations.    -How your staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: I observed an unlabeled bottle in the infant classroom.     I observed unlabeled cups in the Toddler 2 classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Written feeding instructions are needed for two infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The CPSC certification was last completed 08/05/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Medication stored for one child enrolled was not in the original container.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The Emergency Practices form was reviewed and showed the operation completed one shelter in place drill on 03/25/21. Severe weather drills were conducted on 08/03/21 and 10/19/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A caregiver was present without an initial background and was observed in the classroom caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operations building and grounds checklist was reviewed during this inspection. The checklist available for review was dated in the year 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System: The sign in and out sheet in the Primary 1 classroom was reviewed and showed five of fifteen children present were signed in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: The caregiver in the Primary 2 classroom stated 18 children were present. A total of 19 children were observed present in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed cleaning supplies stored next to the hand washing sink in the Toddler 2 classroom.     Note: The cleaning supplies were removed from the hand washing sink during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
